title: Spectrum
empty: No exposure could measure this point.
chart: Flux against wavelength, one point per exposure
hint: The line shows how bright the object is at each wavelength: higher means brighter. Point at a dot to see that measurement.
allDoubtful: Almost every measurement here is doubtful (very bright or crowded target), so the dashed line is only a rough guide.
intro: Measure how bright this point is at each wavelength, using every observation a detector took of it. Nothing is downloaded until you press the button.
stale: This chart belongs to another point. Generate it again to update it.
errorBar: Margin of error (shown when you point at a dot)
every: All six detectors (0.75–5 µm). Takes 1 to 5 minutes.
progress: Measuring… {{done}} of {{total}} detectors done. Each one appears as it finishes.
failed: Could not measure {{detectors}}. Press generate to try again.
